## Overview

Researchers asked for a **Download** button that gives them a file they can open: CSV first,
Excel where a table is small enough, the technical formats further down, and the citation and
licence travelling inside every download. A dataset page already offers the release Parquet and a
CF netCDF, and ERDDAP refuses a whole-table CSV, so none of those is that file. This notebook
makes it, for every dataset in the promoted release, generic over `dataset_key` like
`publish_to-netcdf.qmd` and `publish_to-edi.qmd`.

**One zip per format, named so it is recognisable in Downloads:**
`calcofi_{dataset_key}_{version}_{format}.zip` (`calcofi_bottle_v2026.11.14_csv.zip`,
`calcofi_swfsc_ichthyo_v2026.11.14_xlsx.zip`; the `calcofi_` prefix is not doubled). Each unzips
to one folder of the same name holding:

| file | what |
|---|---|
| `README.md` | what the dataset is, who collected it, the release and its date, every file and its rows, how the tables join, what was left out and where to get it, the Explorer for a subset, the dataset's page, register-your-use and stay-informed |
| `CITATION.md`, `CITATION.bib` | the provider's citation where there is one (said plainly where there is not), always the release's with its DOI |
| `LICENSE.txt` | the legal code for a recognised licence id; the provider's terms URL for `custom`; a plain "no licence has been established" and whom to ask otherwise |
| `columns.csv` | every column: table, type, units, meaning, from the release's own `metadata.json` |
| the tables | `.csv`, one `.xlsx` workbook (a README sheet first), or `.parquet` |

**Which tables, cut how** (`calcofi4db::bundle_plan()`, one rule each, tested): the record's own
`tables[]` plus the shared tables a download needs to be used alone, `sample`, `cruise`, `taxon`
and `measurement_type`; a table with a `dataset_key` keeps this dataset's rows, `sample` also
keeps the samples the dataset's rows sit on (a derived product's observations sit on the bottle or
CTD casts) and their parents, a shared vocabulary keeps the rows reached through its key, and the
full-resolution supplementals (`obs_ctd_full`, `obs_mets_full`: hundreds of millions of rows
partitioned by cruise) are left out and named in the README. `obs` is read through the catalog's
own view over `obs_bio` and `obs_env`.

**A row reads without a join** (`calcofi4db::bundle_build_tables()`): beside `sample_key` the
station the provider recorded (`site_key`) and its CalCOFI `line` and `station`, which a field
scientist asked for; beside `taxon_key` the `scientific_name` and `common_name`; beside
`measurement_type` its `units`. Geometry and H3 cell-id columns are left out (`latitude` and
`longitude` stay; a 64-bit cell id does not survive a spreadsheet).

**Excel only where it fits** (`calcofi4db::bundle_format_decision()`): a workbook is made when
every table fits an Excel sheet: at most 1,048,575 rows of data below the header row
(`BUNDLE_XLSX_MAX_ROWS`, Excel's own 1,048,576-row limit; no lower cap, by the owner's decision of
2026-11-16); otherwise the manifest says why in plain words, and a CSV too long for a
spreadsheet says so in its README.

**Rebuilt only when the dataset changed.** Every release re-renders every publisher, so each
dataset's bundle carries an input fingerprint (`publish_fingerprint()`): the row signatures of
exactly the tables it writes, so a vocabulary row another dataset added changes nothing here; its
catalog record and the metadata its documents read; and this code. An unchanged fingerprint with
the zips still on disk is reused under the release it was built from (its name keeps that version;
`checked_version` records this run). The zips are byte-reproducible (`bundle_zip()`: fixed member
order, timestamp, mode and time zone; the workbook's own timestamp fixed too), so the same rows
always give the same sha256.

**Upload gated, and the website's contract.** Everything is written under
`cc_stage_path("publish", "zip")`; nothing leaves the machine unless `CALCOFI_PUBLISH_ZIP=true`
(and never in a staging run). The upload puts each zip at
`gs://calcofi-db/publish/zip/{dataset_key}/{file}` and the manifest at
`gs://calcofi-db/publish/zip/manifest.json`, which calcofi.io reads at build time, and which
`release_database.qmd` passes to `build_dataset_catalog(bundles = )` so the next release's
`datasets.json` carries a `kind = "bundle"` distribution per file (the newest built, as the
netCDF manifests do).

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

librarian::shelf(DBI, duckdb, dplyr, glue, jsonlite, digest, readr, tibble, knitr, here, quiet = TRUE)
here <- here::here
options(readr.show_col_types = FALSE)
# the engine package from its sibling checkout, as every publisher loads it; CALCOFI4DB_DIR points a
# worktree's render at that worktree's calcofi4db
PKG_DIR <- Sys.getenv("CALCOFI4DB_DIR", here("../calcofi4db"))
devtools::load_all(PKG_DIR)
stopifnot("calcofi4db >= 4.40.0 (bundle_plan) is required" = exists("bundle_plan"))

# the promoted release by default; a STAGING run (CALCOFI_RELEASE_PREFIX=ducklake-staging/releases)
# reads the staging release, writes under data/zip-staging/ and uploads nothing
RELEASE_PREFIX <- Sys.getenv("CALCOFI_RELEASE_PREFIX", "ducklake/releases")
STAGING        <- grepl("staging", RELEASE_PREFIX, fixed = TRUE)
BASE_HTTPS     <- "https://storage.googleapis.com/calcofi-db"
RELEASE_VERSION <- Sys.getenv("CALCOFI_RELEASE_VERSION", "")
if (!nzchar(RELEASE_VERSION))
  RELEASE_VERSION <- trimws(readLines(glue("{BASE_HTTPS}/{RELEASE_PREFIX}/latest.txt"), warn = FALSE)[1])
Sys.setenv(CALCOFI_RELEASE_VERSION = RELEASE_VERSION)   # calcofi4r::cc_catalog() resolves the same one

# comma-separated dataset_keys to restrict a run while iterating; empty = every public dataset
ONLY <- Filter(nzchar, trimws(strsplit(Sys.getenv("CALCOFI_DATASETS", ""), ",")[[1]]))

PUBLISH    <- identical(Sys.getenv("CALCOFI_PUBLISH_ZIP"), "true") && !STAGING   # opt-in upload
NO_PUBLISH <- !PUBLISH

# bulk under the stage root, never in the git tree; the small manifests beside the notebook
STAGE_DIR <- cc_stage_path("publish", if (STAGING) "zip-staging" else "zip", create = TRUE)
OBJ_CACHE <- cc_stage_path("publish", "objects", create = TRUE)   # release objects, content-addressed
OUT_DIR   <- here(if (STAGING) "data/zip-staging" else "data/zip")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ZIP_GCS   <- "gs://calcofi-db/publish/zip"
# the code the bundles are a function of: a change here rebuilds them
LIC_DIR    <- file.path(PKG_DIR, "inst", "licenses")
CODE_FILES <- c(here("publish_to-zip.qmd"), file.path(PKG_DIR, "R", "bundle.R"),
                sort(list.files(LIC_DIR, full.names = TRUE)))

cat(glue("release prefix : {RELEASE_PREFIX}{if (STAGING) ' (STAGING)' else ''}"), "\n")
cat(glue("release        : {RELEASE_VERSION}"), "\n")
cat(glue("calcofi4db     : {PKG_DIR} ({as.character(utils::packageVersion('calcofi4db'))})"), "\n")
cat(glue("stage (zips)   : {STAGE_DIR}"), "\n")
cat(glue("manifests      : {OUT_DIR}"), "\n")
cat(glue("CALCOFI_PUBLISH_ZIP : {PUBLISH} (upload to {ZIP_GCS}/ only when true)"), "\n")
if (length(ONLY)) cat(glue("restricted to  : {paste(ONLY, collapse = ', ')}"), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: fetch-release-json
rel_url  <- function(f) glue("{BASE_HTTPS}/{RELEASE_PREFIX}/{RELEASE_VERSION}/{f}")
read_j   <- function(u) jsonlite::fromJSON(u, simplifyVector = FALSE)
catalog  <- calcofi4r::cc_catalog(RELEASE_VERSION)
ds_json  <- read_j(rel_url("datasets.json"))
meta     <- read_j(rel_url("metadata.json"))
release  <- list(version = RELEASE_VERSION, release_date = catalog$release_date %||% NA,
                 citation = catalog$citation %||% NA, doi = catalog$doi %||% NA,
                 concept_doi = catalog$concept_doi %||% NA)
records  <- setNames(ds_json$datasets, vapply(ds_json$datasets, `[[`, "", "dataset_key"))
public   <- names(records)[vapply(records, function(r) identical(r$visibility %||% "public", "public"), TRUE)]
keys     <- if (length(ONLY)) intersect(public, ONLY) else public
if (length(ONLY) && length(setdiff(ONLY, public)))
  cat(glue("NOTE requested but not a public dataset of {RELEASE_VERSION}: {paste(setdiff(ONLY, public), collapse = ', ')}"), "\n")
cat(glue("{length(keys)} dataset(s) of {length(records)} in the release; ",
         "{length(ds_json$holdings %||% list())} holding(s) have no release data and get no bundle"), "\n")
```

## Read the release

Every table a bundle reads is resolved through the catalog (`calcofi4r::cc_release_sources()`,
never a hand-built path) and its objects copied once into a content-addressed cache under the
stage root, so twenty datasets do not read the same `sample` object over HTTPS twenty times, and
an object unchanged since the previous release is never fetched again. `obs` is the catalog's own
view over `obs_bio` and `obs_env` (`calcofi4r::cc_view_sql()`).

```{r}
#| label: connect
con <- get_duckdb_con()
for (s in c("SET enable_progress_bar = false", "SET preserve_insertion_order = true"))
  dbExecute(con, s)

cat_tables <- catalog$tables
cat_entry  <- function(tb) Find(function(t) identical(t$name, tb), cat_tables)
views      <- calcofi4r::cc_catalog_views(catalog)
supp       <- vapply(Filter(function(t) isTRUE(t$supplemental), cat_tables), `[[`, "", "name")
supp_rows  <- vapply(supp, function(tb) as.numeric(cat_entry(tb)$rows %||% NA), 1)

# every table some bundle may read: the records' tables plus the companions, minus supplementals
want <- setdiff(unique(c(unlist(lapply(records[keys], `[[`, "tables")), "sample", "cruise", "taxon",
                         "measurement_type")), supp)
fetch_local <- function(src) {
  paths <- file.path(OBJ_CACHE, src$local_paths)
  for (i in seq_along(paths)) {
    if (file.exists(paths[i])) next
    dir.create(dirname(paths[i]), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    part <- paste0(paths[i], ".part")
    curl::curl_download(src$urls[i], part, quiet = TRUE)
    file.rename(part, paths[i])
  }
  paths
}
rp <- function(tb) {
  src <- calcofi4r::cc_release_sources(catalog, tb, base_https = BASE_HTTPS)
  calcofi4r::cc_read_parquet_sql(src, paths = fetch_local(src))
}
t0 <- Sys.time()
from_sql <- setNames(vapply(want, function(tb) {
  if (tb %in% names(views)) paste0("(", calcofi4r::cc_view_sql(catalog, tb, rp), ")") else
  if (!is.null(cat_entry(tb))) rp(tb) else NA_character_
}, ""), want)
from_sql <- from_sql[!is.na(from_sql)]
table_columns <- lapply(from_sql, function(f) dbGetQuery(con, glue("DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM {f}"))$column_name)
cat(glue("{length(from_sql)} tables resolved and cached in {round(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = 'secs'))} s ",
         "({round(sum(file.size(list.files(OBJ_CACHE, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE))) / 1e6)} MB in the object cache)"), "\n")
```

## The plan: every dataset, before anything is written

```{r}
#| label: plan
plans <- lapply(setNames(keys, keys), function(k)
  bundle_plan(records[[k]], table_columns, supplemental = supp, supplemental_rows = supp_rows))
plan_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(names(plans), function(k) plans[[k]] |> mutate(dataset_key = k, .before = 1)))
write_csv(plan_tbl, file.path(OUT_DIR, "plan.csv"), na = "")
kable(plan_tbl |> filter(!included | source == "record") |> select(dataset_key, table, rule, link, reason),
      caption = glue("tables each dataset names (companions sample/cruise/taxon/measurement_type are added where reached); {RELEASE_VERSION}"))
```

## Build, or reuse what did not change

```{r}
#| label: build
#| results: asis

read_prior <- function() {
  p <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "manifest.json")
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(list())
  m <- tryCatch(read_j(p), error = function(e) NULL)
  setNames(m$datasets %||% list(), vapply(m$datasets %||% list(), `[[`, "", "dataset_key"))
}
prior_all  <- read_prior()
code_parts <- publish_code_parts(CODE_FILES)
cols_meta  <- meta$columns %||% list()
tbls_meta  <- meta$tables %||% list()
entries <- list(); runs <- list()

for (k in keys) {
  t0   <- Sys.time()
  rec  <- records[[k]]
  plan <- plans[[k]]
  built <- bundle_build_tables(con, plan, k, from_sql)
  fp <- publish_fingerprint(
    data     = bundle_table_signatures(con, built$table),
    metadata = list(
      record  = publish_record_digest(rec),
      columns = cols_meta[sub("\\..*$", "", names(cols_meta)) %in% built$table],
      tables  = tbls_meta[intersect(built$table, names(tbls_meta))],
      plan    = plan[, c("table", "included", "rule", "link", "reason")],
      built   = built[, c("table", "dropped", "added")]),
    code     = code_parts)
  prior <- prior_all[[k]]
  files <- vapply(Filter(function(b) isTRUE(b$written), prior$bundles %||% list()), `[[`, "", "file")
  dec <- publish_decide(fp, prior$input_fingerprint, file.path(STAGE_DIR, k, files))
  if (dec$action == "reuse") {
    e <- prior
    e$checked_version <- RELEASE_VERSION
    cat(glue("- `{k}`: unchanged since {e$version} — reused ({length(files)} zip(s))"), "\n")
  } else {
    w <- write_bundle(con, rec, release, built, plan, file.path(STAGE_DIR, k),
                      meta_columns = cols_meta, meta_tables = tbls_meta, licenses_dir = LIC_DIR)
    lic <- bundle_license(rec, LIC_DIR); cit <- bundle_citation(rec, release)
    e <- bundle_manifest_entry(rec, RELEASE_VERSION, release$release_date, RELEASE_VERSION, fp, built, plan, w,
                               license_kind = lic$kind, has_provider_citation = cit$has_provider_citation)
    # a superseded build's zips go; it is reproducible from its frozen release
    old <- setdiff(list.files(file.path(STAGE_DIR, k), pattern = "\\.zip$"), w$file[w$written])
    unlink(file.path(STAGE_DIR, k, old))
    cat(glue("- `{k}`: built — {dec$reason}; ",
             "{paste(sprintf('%s %s MB', w$format[w$written], format(round(w$bytes[w$written] / 1e6, 1), nsmall = 1)), collapse = ', ')}",
             "{if (length(old)) paste0('; removed ', paste(old, collapse = ', ')) else ''}"), "\n")
  }
  for (tb in built$table) dbExecute(con, glue('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "bundle_{tb}"'))
  entries[[k]] <- e
  runs[[k]] <- tibble(dataset_key = k, action = dec$action, changed = paste(dec$changed, collapse = ","),
                      secs = round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))))
}
```

## The manifest: what the website reads

`data/zip/manifest.json` (and the same file beside the zips) is the contract with calcofi.io:
one entry per dataset with the release its bundles were built from and last confirmed against,
the licence kind, whether the provider gave a citation, every table's rows, what was left out,
and per format either the file (`url`, `bytes`, `sha256`, `excel_openable`) or, for a format not
offered, the reason in plain words. It carries no clock time, so an unchanged run rewrites it
byte for byte. `manifest.csv` is the same per dataset × format, with whether the bucket already
holds those bytes.

```{r}
#| label: manifest
manifest <- list(schema_version = "1.0", generated_by = "publish_to-zip.qmd",
                 release = RELEASE_VERSION, base_url = CC_BUNDLE_BASE_URL,
                 datasets = unname(entries[sort(names(entries))]))
man_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(manifest, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE, null = "null", na = "null", digits = NA)
writeLines(man_json, file.path(OUT_DIR, "manifest.json"))
writeLines(man_json, file.path(STAGE_DIR, "manifest.json"))

# what the bucket holds now, for the upload status
remote <- if (STAGING) NULL else fetch_bundle_manifest()
remote_of <- function(k, f) {
  e <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$dataset_key, k), remote$datasets %||% list())
  if (!length(e)) return(list(sha256 = NA_character_, version = NA_character_))
  b <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$format, f), e[[1]]$bundles %||% list())
  list(sha256 = if (length(b)) b[[1]]$sha256 %||% NA_character_ else NA_character_, version = e[[1]]$version)
}
man_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(entries, function(e) bind_rows(lapply(e$bundles, function(b) {
  r <- remote_of(e$dataset_key, b$format)
  main <- if (length(e$tables)) e$tables[[1]] else list(table = NA, rows = NA)
  tibble(dataset_key = e$dataset_key, format = b$format, written = isTRUE(b$written),
         version = e$version, checked_version = e$checked_version,
         action = runs[[e$dataset_key]]$action, main_table = main$table, main_rows = main$rows,
         file = b$file %||% NA_character_, bytes = b$bytes %||% NA_real_, sha256 = b$sha256 %||% NA_character_,
         excel_openable = isTRUE(b$excel_openable), reason = b$reason %||% "",
         license_kind = e$license_kind, uploaded_hash = r$sha256, uploaded_version = r$version)
})))) |>
  mutate(publish_upload_status(ifelse(written, sha256, NA_character_), uploaded_hash, uploaded_version))
write_csv(man_tbl, file.path(OUT_DIR, "manifest.csv"), na = "")
kable(man_tbl |> mutate(MB = round(bytes / 1e6, 1)) |>
        select(dataset_key, format, written, MB, main_table, main_rows, excel_openable, version, action, upload_status),
      caption = glue("data/zip/manifest.csv — {sum(man_tbl$written)} zip(s) for {length(entries)} dataset(s)"))
```

```{r}
#| label: skipped
sk <- man_tbl |> filter(!written)
if (nrow(sk)) kable(sk |> select(dataset_key, format, reason), caption = "formats not offered, and why") else
  cat("every format was offered for every dataset\n")
```

## Check the zips

For every bundle built in this run: each zip opens, holds one folder named like it with the five
documents and one data file per table, and the observations it carries are the count the
release's own record measured for the dataset (`coverage.n_obs`), an independent tally.

```{r}
#| label: verify
chk <- bind_rows(lapply(entries, function(e) {
  k <- e$dataset_key
  if (runs[[k]]$action != "build") return(NULL)
  n_obs <- records[[k]]$coverage$n_obs %||% NA
  bind_rows(lapply(Filter(function(b) isTRUE(b$written), e$bundles), function(b) {
    zl <- zip::zip_list(file.path(STAGE_DIR, k, b$file))
    stem <- sub("\\.zip$", "", b$file)
    docs <- paste0(stem, "/", c("README.md", "CITATION.md", "CITATION.bib", "LICENSE.txt", "columns.csv"))
    data_files <- if (b$format == "xlsx") paste0(stem, "/", stem, ".xlsx") else
      paste0(stem, "/", vapply(e$tables, `[[`, "", "table"), ".", b$format)
    obs_rows <- b$rows$obs %||% 0
    tibble(dataset_key = k, format = b$format, members = nrow(zl),
           docs_ok = all(docs %in% zl$filename), data_ok = all(data_files %in% zl$filename),
           one_folder = all(startsWith(zl$filename, paste0(stem, "/"))),
           obs_rows = obs_rows, record_n_obs = n_obs,
           obs_ok = is.na(n_obs) || identical(as.numeric(obs_rows), as.numeric(n_obs)))
  }))
}))
if (nrow(chk)) {
  kable(chk, caption = "structure of every zip built in this run")
  bad <- chk |> filter(!docs_ok | !data_ok | !one_folder | !obs_ok)
  stopifnot("every bundle must hold its documents, its tables and the release's observation count" = nrow(bad) == 0)
} else cat("no bundle was built in this run (every dataset reused)\n")
```

## Upload (gated)

Each zip goes to `gs://calcofi-db/publish/zip/{dataset_key}/{file}` (an unchanged object is not
re-uploaded: `put_gcs_file()` compares md5s), then the manifest, then a superseded version's zips
are removed from the bucket, so a page never links a file that is not there.

```{r}
#| label: upload
#| eval: !expr PUBLISH
for (i in which(man_tbl$written & man_tbl$needs_upload)) {
  r <- man_tbl[i, ]
  put_gcs_file(file.path(STAGE_DIR, r$dataset_key, r$file), glue("{ZIP_GCS}/{r$dataset_key}/{r$file}"),
               content_type = "application/zip")
  cat(glue("uploaded {r$dataset_key}/{r$file}"), "\n")
}
put_gcs_file(file.path(STAGE_DIR, "manifest.json"), glue("{ZIP_GCS}/manifest.json"),
             content_type = "application/json")
for (k in names(entries)) {
  keep <- man_tbl$file[man_tbl$dataset_key == k & man_tbl$written]
  have <- list_gcs_files("calcofi-db", prefix = glue("publish/zip/{k}/"))$name
  for (p in setdiff(have[grepl("\\.zip$", have)], glue("publish/zip/{k}/{keep}"))) {
    delete_gcs_prefix(p, bucket = "calcofi-db", dry_run = FALSE)
    cat(glue("  removed superseded gs://calcofi-db/{p}"), "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: upload-skip
#| eval: !expr NO_PUBLISH
due <- man_tbl |> filter(written, needs_upload)
cat(glue("CALCOFI_PUBLISH_ZIP is not `true`{if (STAGING) ' (and this is a staging run)' else ''}: nothing uploaded.\n",
         "{nrow(due)} zip(s) ({round(sum(due$bytes) / 1e6)} MB) differ from what {ZIP_GCS}/ holds; ",
         "they are staged at {STAGE_DIR}/.\n"))
```

```{r}
#| label: timings
kable(bind_rows(runs), caption = "per dataset: reuse or build, what changed, seconds")
```

```{r}
#| label: cleanup
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```
